datagram/test_quic::test_frames_allowed_.justification: SEC-QUIC-3, Go-only by Lee's decision on PRO-124 (commit fe87386): a client Initial in a UDP datagram under 1200 bytes is one a server discards (RFC 9000 section 14.1), so Go reports it malformed and feeds nothing to the assembler; the frozen Python reference identified it. The same divergence is the approved SEC-QUIC-3 class of migration/parity/random_diff.py.
